packageRules.description: Actions embedded in action.yml run on behalf of consumers, so bumps land as 'fix' to cut a patch release and move the v0 tag downstream repos consume. Our release-please config (release-type: simple, default versioning strategy) only bumps the version for 'fix'/'feat'/breaking commits, not 'build' or 'chore' - so this must stay 'fix' to actually trigger a release.
Actions used only by this repo's own CI/CD workflows don't affect consumers, so keep them as chores - no need to cut a release for internal tooling bumps.
this-is-tobi/github-workflows is referenced via its moving v0 major tag on purpose - don't pin or bump it.
